title: Frosted souls
description: A very simple mod that adds blizzards as a weather challenge
body:
# Frosted souls

this mod is an addon to the **Cold Sweat** mod

I made this for my own modpack but is useable in other experinces that use harsh winters as a setting

adds highly configrable blizzards that arrive (by default) every 15 days, with a mega variation coming every 60 days.

the day intervals can be changed and so can they be turned on or off in settings

#

to deal with them there are diffrent tiers of hearths that are craftable, but you will need CrafTweaker or KubeJS to add your own recipies to the items

![hearths](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/00e1c207ca1b36b36954e451c4fa6183e4c82206_0.webp)


#
![frosted soul](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/533185b0ba70a2a5224a6626ce7d8ea2f8b3ca26.png) used to make a lot of recipies from the nether, they are found in ice spikes and frozen oceans

![blazing soul](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8216dd2f6c05e81510870d8ff8dc5d1635611a82.png) made with frosted souls and used to make blaze burners

Please note this is my first mod ever, feel free to go in and improve the code if you are skilled!
